name: Rapicut Carbides Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1977, Rapicut Carbides Ltd manufactures Tungsten Carbide products used in metal cutting, mining, wear parts and various other industries[1]
keyPoints:
Product Profile:[1]
a) Mining Products:[2]
Drill Steel Inserts, Octagonal and Square Inserts, Tungsten Carbide Buttons, Bucket Wheel Excavation (BWE) Inserts, Carset/Cross Bits Inserts, Flow Beans/ Nozzles, etc.
b) Wear Parts:[3]
Tungsten Carbide Seal Rings, Pellets/Nibs, Jute Eyelets, etc.
c) Metal Cutting:[4]
2000 different varieties of standard tips, apart from custom-built special tips
d) Intermediates:[5]
Tungsten Metal Powder, Tungsten Carbide Powder, Fused Tungsten Carbide Powder, Ready to Press Powder, etc.
e) Finished Product:[6]
Stem and seat for High Pressure Control Valve, Tungsten Carbide Seat for pneumatic valve, Scarfing tools and Pressure/ Squeeze Rolls for ERW Tube, Forming tools for various Industry. Company supplies Flats, segments, Bushes, Rods, Brazed Tools etc. for various applications

cons: Stock is trading at 3.14 times its book value
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 4.69% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of -5.24% over last 3 years.
